items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Salmon's daddy, Lawrence's daddy was Billy Moran, he was the number one bass player.

ctx.x: The family seemed so musical. Musical, yeah. I wondered if it came to him for it.

Well, I don't know what's on the phrase. My father was honest when I was, no, well wait now, Salmon's daddy, Lawrence's daddy was Billy Moran, he was the number one bass player. Yeah. Yeah, he played with the old time superior band. That consists of Peter Bocaught playing trumpet and violin. And I think there's Walter Brunnen, I can't remember all the men's them days, that's way back. He called it the superior band.
We have a picture of that old band. That band, yeah. Well that's Peter Bocaught. Walter Brunnen, I believe, on drums.
